# Pivot

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public enum Pivot
```

Which point of the model's bounding box is moved to the origin.

## Values

- <span id="f-bottomcenter"></span>`BottomCenter = 0` - The center of the box's bottom face: X and Z centered, the lowest Y at zero — what a model standing on a floor wants.
- <span id="f-center"></span>`Center = 1` - The center of the box.
- <span id="f-mincorner"></span>`MinCorner = 2` - The box's minimum corner: every coordinate is zero or more.
